title_en: Regulations on Financial Asset Management Companies

articles.content_en: These Regulations are formulated to regulate the activities of financial asset management companies, deal with non-performing loans of state-owned banks according to law, and promote the reform and development of state-owned banks and state-owned enterprises.

Financial asset management companies refer to wholly state-owned non-banking financial institutions established upon decision of the State Council to acquire non-performing loans of state-owned banks, and to manage and dispose of assets formed from the acquisition of non-performing loans of state-owned banks.
Financial asset management companies shall, with maximizing asset preservation and minimizing losses as their main operational objectives, independently bear civil liability according to law.

The People's Bank of China, the Ministry of Finance and the China Securities Regulatory Commission shall, in accordance with their respective statutory duties, exercise supervision and administration over financial asset management companies.
The registered capital of a financial asset management company shall be RMB 10 billion, allocated by the Ministry of Finance.

A financial asset management company shall be issued a "Financial Institution Legal Person Permit" by the People's Bank of China, and shall undergo registration with the administrative department for industry and commerce according to law.

For the establishment of branches, a financial asset management company shall obtain the consent of the Ministry of Finance and submit to the People's Bank of China for approval, shall be issued a "Financial Institution Business Permit" by the People's Bank of China, and shall undergo registration with the administrative department for industry and commerce according to law.

A financial asset management company shall have one president and several vice-presidents. The president and vice-presidents shall be appointed by the State Council. The president shall exercise powers on behalf of the financial asset management company externally, and shall be responsible for the operation and management of the financial asset management company.
The senior officers of a financial asset management company shall have their qualifications examined by the People's Bank of China.

The composition, duties and working procedures of the board of supervisors of a financial asset management company shall be implemented in accordance with the Interim Regulations on the Board of Supervisors of Key State-owned Financial Institutions.

A financial asset management company shall acquire non-performing loans of state-owned banks within the scope and amount determined by the State Council; if the acquisition exceeds the determined scope or amount, special approval from the State Council shall be obtained.

Within the amount determined by the State Council, a financial asset management company shall acquire, at book value, the principal of relevant loans and the corresponding accrued interest receivable that has been recognized in profit or loss; for accrued interest receivable not recognized in profit or loss, a free transfer shall be effected.

After acquiring non-performing loans, a financial asset management company shall immediately obtain all rights of the original creditors against the debtors. The debtors, guarantors and relevant parties under the original loan contracts shall continue to perform the obligations stipulated in the contracts.

The sources of funds for a financial asset management company to acquire non-performing loans include:
(1) the transfer of part of the reloans extended by the People's Bank of China to wholly state-owned commercial banks;
(2) the issuance of financial bonds.
The reloans extended by the People's Bank of China to wholly state-owned commercial banks which are transferred to the financial asset management company shall be subject to a fixed interest rate at an annual rate of 2.25%.
The issuance of financial bonds by a financial asset management company shall be subject to the approval of the People's Bank of China in conjunction with the Ministry of Finance.

A financial asset management company may convert the creditor's rights obtained from acquiring non-performing loans of state-owned banks into equity in the borrowing enterprises.
The equity held by a financial asset management company shall not be subject to the proportion restrictions of its net asset value or registered capital.

In implementing debt-to-equity conversion, the national industrial policy shall be implemented, which shall be conducive to optimizing the economic structure and promoting technological progress and product upgrading of relevant enterprises.

Enterprises implementing debt-to-equity conversion shall be recommended by the State Economic and Trade Commission to the financial asset management company. The financial asset management company shall conduct an independent evaluation of the recommended enterprises, formulate a debt-to-equity conversion plan for the enterprises, and sign a debt-to-equity conversion agreement with the enterprises. The debt-to-equity conversion plan and agreement shall be reviewed by the State Economic and Trade Commission in conjunction with the Ministry of Finance and the People's Bank of China, and shall be submitted to the State Council for approval before implementation.

Enterprises implementing debt-to-equity conversion shall, in accordance with the requirements of the modern enterprise system, transform their operational mechanisms, establish a standardized corporate governance structure, and strengthen enterprise management. The relevant local people's governments shall assist enterprises in downsizing staff, increasing efficiency, diverting laid-off workers, and separating social functions from enterprises.

After the debt-to-equity conversion by a financial asset management company, as a shareholder of the enterprise, it may send representatives to participate in the board of directors and the board of supervisors of the enterprise, and exercise shareholder rights according to law.

The equity held by a financial asset management company in an enterprise may be transferred to domestic and foreign investors in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State, or may be repurchased by the debt-to-equity conversion enterprise according to law.

After implementing debt-to-equity conversion, an enterprise shall, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State, undergo registration for changes in enterprise property rights and other relevant matters.
The State Economic and Trade Commission shall be responsible for organizing, guiding and coordinating the debt-to-equity conversion work of enterprises.

A financial asset management company shall implement an operational target responsibility system.
The Ministry of Finance shall, based on the quality of non-performing loans, determine the operational targets of the financial asset management company for disposing of non-performing loans, and shall conduct assessment and supervision.

A financial asset management company shall, based on the characteristics of non-performing loans, formulate operational policies and relevant measures, improve its internal governance structure, and establish internal restraint and incentive mechanisms.

A financial asset management company shall, in managing and disposing of assets formed from the acquisition of non-performing loans of state-owned banks, operate in accordance with the principles of openness, competition and selection of the best.
A financial asset management company shall mainly adopt methods such as tendering and auctioning when transferring assets.
If the creditor's rights of a financial asset management company cannot be satisfied due to bankruptcy of the debtor or other reasons, the matter shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of the State Council.
The administrative measures for asset disposal of financial asset management companies shall be formulated by the Ministry of Finance.

A financial asset management company may, based on business needs, engage intermediary agencies with qualifications in accounting, asset appraisal, legal services, etc. to assist in conducting business.

A financial asset management company shall be exempt from taxes in the business activities of acquiring non-performing loans of state-owned banks and undertaking and disposing of assets formed from the acquisition of non-performing loans of state-owned banks. Specific measures shall be formulated by the Ministry of Finance in conjunction with the State Administration of Taxation.
A financial asset management company shall be exempt from administrative charges such as industrial and commercial registration fees.

A financial asset management company shall, in accordance with the requirements of the People's Bank of China, the Ministry of Finance, the China Securities Regulatory Commission and other relevant departments, submit financial and statistical reports and other relevant materials.

A financial asset management company shall accept audit supervision by the audit authorities according to law.
A financial asset management company shall engage certified public accountants recognized by the Ministry of Finance to conduct an annual audit of its financial status, and shall promptly submit the audit report to all relevant supervisory and administrative departments.
When a financial asset management company is terminated, the Ministry of Finance shall organize a liquidation group to carry out liquidation.

The final losses arising from the disposal of non-performing loans by a financial asset management company shall have a solution proposed by the Ministry of Finance, which shall be submitted to the State Council for approval and implementation.

If a financial asset management company violates financial laws and administrative regulations, it shall be punished by the People's Bank of China in accordance with the relevant laws and the Measures on Punishment for Financial Violations; if it violates other relevant laws and administrative regulations, it shall be punished by the relevant departments according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
These Regulations shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
